title: Lakers LeBron James Reacts To Trade Deadline Rumors [Watch]
htmlContent:
The Los Angeles Lakers suffered a tough loss on Saturday night against the New Orleans Pelicans, with a final score of 115-110. Despite a strong start by the Lakers, they were unable to maintain their lead and were overtaken by the Pelican's talented roster.

The Lakers were led by LeBron James, who had a solid performance with 27 points, 8 rebounds, and 7 assists. However, the Lakers lacked the supporting cast necessary to secure the win against a talented Pelican's team. The Pelicans were led by Brandon Ingram, who had a standout game with 37 points and 9 rebounds.

The Lakers faced numerous challenges throughout the game, including foul trouble and inconsistent shooting. Despite these difficulties, they remained competitive and kept the game close throughout. In the end, however, the Pelicans were able to capitalize on the Lakers' mistakes and secure the win.

This loss is a setback for the Lakers, who have been struggling to find their rhythm this season. With this defeat, the Lakers now have a 17-19 record and will need to regroup and refocus if they hope to make a push for the playoffs. On the other hand, the Pelicans will look to build upon this victory and continue their climb up the Western Conference standings.

Overall, the Saturday night matchup between the Lakers and Pelicans was a hard-fought battle, but ultimately, the Pelicans came out on top. Both teams will look to move forward and improve in their upcoming games.

After the game LeBron James was asked about trade deadline rumors involving Kyrie Irving.

"I don't speak for the front office. My mindset is that whatever lineup or whatever group that we have is to make sure we prepare ourselves the best way we can and go out and win."
